Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the tabletop last week — useful session. Aurora Fin's compliance team has followed up with a narrow request: they want a small subset of artifacts that demonstrate our RTO/RPO assertions for the inference product used in their production tenant. Specifically they asked for:

- the keystore/restore timeline from the May 20 warmstart (sanitized)
